notes.text:
An update is available for ruby4.0.
This update affects Rocky Linux 10.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
Ruby is the interpreted scripting language for quick and easy object-oriented programming.  It has many features to process text files and to do system management tasks (as in Perl).  It is simple, straight-forward, and extensible.

Security Fix(es):

* ruby: integer overflow issue in regular expression compiler (CVE-2026-93577)

* ruby: integer overflow issue in CI/CD regular expression compiler (CVE-2026-97229)

* ruby: integer overflow issue in regular expression compiler (CVE-2026-110264)

* ruby: ruby: Heap-based buffer overflow via string case conversion (CVE-2026-132825)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* ruby4.0: Rebase to the latest Ruby 4.0 release [rhel-10] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-260673)

* ruby4.0: Rebase to the latest Ruby 4.0 release [rhel-10.3.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-312591)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
